User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the DocuFlow application. Authentication is handled externally, so this entity primarily stores user identification and role information within the application context.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

email.description: The user's email address, used for identification and communication.

displayName.description: The preferred name or alias for the user.

role.description: The role assigned to the user within the application.

creationDateTime.description: Timestamp indicating when the user's record was created in the system.

status.description: The current status of the user account.

provisionedBy.description: The email of the administrator who manually provisioned this account, if applicable.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last modification.

File.title: File
File.description: Represents a PDF or other document file uploaded by a user or generated by an operation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the File entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who owns or uploaded this file.

originalFileName.description: The original name of the file.

storagePath.description: The path or URL where the file is physically stored.

mimeType.description: The MIME type of the file.

fileSize.description: The size of the file in bytes.

uploadDateTime.description: Timestamp indicating when the file was uploaded.

status.description: The current status of the file.

Operation.title: Operation
Operation.description: Records details of each PDF processing operation performed by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Operation entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who initiated this operation.

operationType.description: The type of PDF operation performed.

status.description: The current status of the operation.

definition.description: Administrator markers for system intelligence access.
